title: Online sessions with the International Higher School of Medicine

blocks.text: From 20 February to 13 March 2025, the International Higher School of Medicine (IHSM) held online sessions for the quality assurance team under Work Package 3, Quality Assurance System, of the Erasmus+ GREENKG project. The training was delivered by GREENKG external expert Nazokat Anvarovna Kasymova, Doctor of Political Science and professor at Tashkent State University of Oriental Studies, Uzbekistan.
